provenance.source: Peugeot, PEUGEOT 308 Racing Cup: der geborene Racer (press release, 4 September 2015)
provenance.notes: Race version of the 308 GTi by Peugeot Sport, presented at the 2015 Frankfurt motor show.

provenance.source: Peugeot, Entregado el primer PEUGEOT 308 Racing Cup (press release, 2016)
provenance.notes: Orders opened on 30 October 2016 and the first customer car was delivered that year: start of the generation. No end of production found in an official source, so the generation is left open.

provenance.source: Peugeot Sport, PEUGEOT 308TCR: six cars ready to take on TCR Europe (press release, 2018)
provenance.notes: The 308TCR, revealed in January 2018, was developed from the 308 Racing Cup; it is a separate car and is not part of this variant.
External ids of the make and the model; the name 308 II of the second generation, on which the 308 GTi and the Racing Cup are based.
